run_eval_cli: run the evaluation script with --results flag to compute FID and diversity metrics on a .npy file
calculate_diversity: calculate the diversity of activations by computing pairwise distances between random sample pairs
calculate_activation_statistics: calculate the mean and covariance of an array of activations for distribution comparison
calculate_frechet_distance: calculate the Fréchet distance between two distributions given their mean vectors and covariance matrices
summarize_eval_module: summarize the eval module that computes cross-sample variance, static FID, kinematic FID, and diversity metrics
